newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spescom, Quante form new unit.
newsitem.headline: Spescom, Quante form new unit.

text.p: Spescom Electronics Ltd and Quante AG have teamed up to form Quante Spescom (Pty) Ltd, a joint venture company which will import, manufacture and distribute Quante products throughout southern Africa, the companies said on Thursday.
They said the new company would challenge Siemens, Krone and 3M Corporation for a southern Africa market share "conservatively valued at more than 300 million rand over the next four years".
Quante manufactures telecommunication connector systems, fibre optics, transmission signalling equipment and micro-PABX products.
